*First published on Medium for Scuzzbucket ([link to original post)](https://medium.com/scuzzbucket/back-from-the-dread-6c7d496132a0?sk=6d5889f259f8b19a67b17309322f6e5b).*

The life I lead — Or is it “led”?\
A trotting steed — Where did it tread?

The soil, it slips — I wasn’t ready\
Unmoored, unclipped — I’m feeling heavy

O Muse, I plead — Sing me your creed\
Steady my step — Mark my blood red\
Or go in my stead — Gallop with pep

Leave me to bleed — A restful end\
Or simply to breathe — As my wits mend

’Til again I lead — Not the life I led\
But a life freed — Untamed, undead.
